note: These programs change scope and payouts over weeks. Unit 1 teaches you to re-check each one live before you spend a day attacking for it. Verify every row at its own URL the day you submit.

news.line: Gray Swan ran a $30k Indirect Prompt Injection arena. Agent arenas are the fastest route to a paid network.
Anthropic's Model Safety Bug Bounty runs on HackerOne, reward up to ~$35k for a verified universal jailbreak.
Google's AI VRP pays up to $30k but explicitly excludes plain jailbreaks and prompt injection. Read scope before you aim.
0din (Mozilla) and HackAPrompt take findings and writeups from newcomers. Lowest barrier to a first accepted report.
